trechos.trecho: Today when I opened my laptop anki I was prompted to conduct a full sync and it appears that I have lost all of the progress on the cards I have completed in the past two days

trechos.trecho: lost my review streak (544 days). Ideally, I would like to rectify the review count on my laptop anki, preferably not lose the reviews I have done in the past two days
trechos.contexto: Reclamação de perda de streak e pedido para recuperar dados

trechos.trecho: On iOS: Tap the red sync button. If you see a message about a full sync / one-way sync or a conflict (Upload vs Download): Choose Upload to AnkiWeb.
trechos.contexto: Instruções técnicas (tarefa manual) para resolução do problema no iOS

trechos.trecho: On laptop Anki: First, create a local backup: File → Export → All decks with scheduling and media → save the .colpkg somewhere safe.
trechos.contexto: Instruções técnicas (tarefa manual) para criar backup em laptop
